messages:
Priya: heads-up — Bellatrix flagged a regression after we merged their LoRA into deltafusion-v2 and pushed an int3 quant profile. can we triage quickly?
Dan: on it. got any numbers and the exact merge command?
Priya: baseline (FP16 + bellatrix-lora-v1) quickprobe-8 invoice exact-match = 0.842. after merge+int3: 0.781. customer also reports tokenization differences (commas, truncated cents).
Bellatrix-PS: (customer) we started seeing missing '.00' and some amounts like 1,200 -> 12,00 after that merge. started yesterday afternoon.
Mike: sounds like tokenizer id remapping + quantization noise. if the merge replaced tokenizer files, token ids can shift and downstream amount parsers break. Priya — what flags used for merge?
Priya: this was the engineer command:```bash
redwood merge --base deltafusion-v2 --adapter bellatrix-lora-v1 \
  --out bellatrix-merged-df2 --quant int3 --preserve-tokenizer false
```
Alisa: yep — `--preserve-tokenizer false` would overwrite token mappings. that explains token shifts.
Dan: i'll spin a dev job to reproduce: run quickprobe with (1) fp16+preserve-tokenizer, (2) int3+preserve-tokenizer, (3) int3+replace-tokenizer.
Mike: i'll assemble a focused eval pack `bellatrix-amount-quickprobe-v1` (30 prompts: commas, parentheses, currency symbols, hyphenated amounts, spaces). will run batch=8.
Priya: thanks. customer can wait for the repro.
deploy-bot: job jb_2026_204 started (ETA ~10m).
Bellatrix-PS: thanks — please include a smoketest pointer we can run on our side before full rollout.
Mike: first-pass results (summary):
- fp16 + preserve-tokenizer: exact-match 0.840
- int3 + preserve-tokenizer: exact-match 0.833
- int3 + replace-tokenizer: exact-match 0.679
So biggest delta is tokenizer replacement; int3 alone is only a small regression.
Priya: actionable: revert that merge (or re-merge with `--preserve-tokenizer true`) for Bellatrix. add a pre-merge safety check that warns when tokenizer delta > 0.05 (token-id alignment metric).
Dan: i'll open a PR to add that check and a new explicit flag `--force-tokenizer-replace` so accidental swaps are opt-in.
Mike: also proposing a post-merge mini-ci: 5 amount/date prompts run automatically; if exact-match drops > 0.05 vs baseline, block auto-promotion. i'll sketch the test.
Alisa: add to release notes: tokenizer replacement is opt-in during adapter merges; list common breakages like amounts, ordinal numbers, and punctuation-sensitive rules.
Bellatrix-PS: that plan works for us. once you re-merge with preserve-tokenizer=true we'll smoke on our prod mirror and confirm.
Priya: i'll coordinate the safe re-merge now and paste PR + changelist here when done. thanks team!
